review_notes: Prose/HTML and tool-name-list grep matches are not date calls.
Generated date +%%s strings produce date +%s and are zone-independent epoch checks.
Python chained now().astimezone() is aware after conversion; the source-local formatting dependency is recorded without claiming it loses the instant.
This is a bounded static audit of direct forms, not whole-program dynamic or alias tracing. Vendor timer files outside the named roots and shell startup files were not read.

~/.local/bin/cc-clock-context:9 uses date -u; :10 uses TZ=America/New_York for display. Other local-bin time candidates are explicitly zoned. No unzoned local-bin call was found by the bounded search.
The native-agent-pages-refresh.timer symlink is read only through its explicitly named user-unit path; no target directory was crawled.
path_convention: ~ aliases the runtime user's home. Host home paths in command metadata and snippets are masked for publication; expanduser before reproducing commands. Repository file:line paths and revision SHAs are unchanged.
